text:
alex_customer: Heads up — after the client SDK 2.1.4 rollout some of our /embeddings requests are failing with "dimension mismatch" and we're seeing intermittent tail latencies >8s. Happened ~30x in last hour. Trace: tr-9a7f. Using model=redwood-embed-1536.
jess_support: Sorry about that, can you paste a minimal repro + the exact error body? Do you have max_batch_size and dynamic batching flags set on your route? Also which region?
alex_customer: region=us-west-2. Our route uses dynamic batching (default), max_batch_size=16. Error body below:
```
HTTP 400
{
  "error": "dimension_mismatch",
  "message": "expected 1536 but got 1024 in batch",
  "trace_id": "tr-9a7f"
}
```
We send batch of 3 inputs, sometimes works, sometimes this 400. Example incoming payload (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1536",
  "input": ["doc a","doc b","doc c"]
}
```
jess_support: thx. Two hypotheses: 1) variant fallback — some requests routed to a smaller-embed variant that returns 1024 dim; 2) a batching bug mixing responses from two model variants in one coalesced response. Will dig.
mike_infra: I pulled the batcher logs for tr-9a7f. Found this sequence on the shard that handled the batch:
```
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z INFO batch_create id=bx-347 model_hint=redwood-embed-1536
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z WARN model_fallback chosen=redwood-embed-1024 reason=capacity
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z INFO batch_execute id=bx-347 variants_in_batch=[redwood-embed-1536, redwood-embed-1024]
2026-03-17T14:12:04Z ERROR batch_validate id=bx-347 dims_mismatch
```
Looks like dynamic routing allowed a fallback to a 1024-dim variant and the batcher ended up combining them.
sara_oncall: @luis_eng can you confirm if routing fallback should be disabled for embed routes, or if the batcher should reject mixed-variant batches? This is an SLA-impacting 400.
luis_eng: Confirmed — model variants with different embedding dims must never be coalesced. There's supposed to be a check in the coalesce path that groups by output_dim but I see a regression in the last batcher refactor (PR #4218). Repro steps I ran:
1) run emulator that sends 3 concurrent small embed requests pinned to redwood-embed-1536
2) temporarily force capacity shortfall for 1536 variant
3) observe batcher log shows fallback and mixed variants -> 400
I can patch quickly to add a defensive check and make fallback opt-in per-route.
jess_support: Mitigations for now:
- If you can, pin your requests to a specific variant: set model to redwood-embed-1536 (not just model family) or set route config to disable variant_fallback.
- Temporary workaround: set max_batch_size=1 on the route to avoid coalescing until we patch.
Here's a sample SDK snippet to pin model:
```js
client.embeddings.create({
  model: "redwood-embed-1536",
  input: ["..."],
})
```
alex_customer: Quick test: pinned to variant and set max_batch_size=1. After 10 minutes I see no more 400s and tail latency back under 200ms. Looks good. We'll keep this while you patch.
deploy-bot: started deploy of infra/patches/batcher-dim-guard@sha1:abc123
mike_infra: Patch added to verify output_dim at coalesce boundary and to refuse to combine cross-dim requests; will also log suspicious fallback decisions.
luis_eng: Rolling a hotfix now, will include a route-level flag to opt-out of fallback for embeddings. ETA ~30m.
deploy-bot: deploy complete for infra/patches/batcher-dim-guard@sha1:abc123 -> success
sara_oncall: Thanks team. @alex_customer can you keep the pinned config for one more hour and confirm stability? We'll monitor traces for new dimension_mismatch errors.
alex_customer: Confirmed stable for 1 hour of soak. We'll keep pinned until your flag is available. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
jess_support: Closing the ticket once you confirm 24h stable. Billing note: this issue didn't trigger billing anomalies. Follow-up: we'll add a doc note about "variant fallback and embedding dims" in the runbook.
